execution_rule: Do not run downstream implementation until preceding pass acceptance is evidenced; independent read-only reviews may proceed
policy: Preserve original lossless decoders and 16-bit/44.1kHz playback floor
Preserve 1KiB Pip-Boy panel and RBPK v1
No unexpected startup scan or autoplay
Do not commit private audio, filenames, paths, or media hashes

passes.title: Baseline and reproducibility
passes.scope: Pin current source; reproduce same-file CLI/GUI and establish selected output route
passes.acceptance: Classify audible CLI versus GUI failure on a usable output route with sanitized commands and observations

passes.title: Repair native GUI playback handoff
passes.scope: Add managed-process regression and fix a proven handoff defect while preserving native decoders
passes.acceptance: A real FLAC is audible from the Mac GUI; tests pass and Playing is truthful

passes.title: Truthful progress and state
passes.scope: Typed playback snapshot, elapsed/duration, output state, pause/end/error reset and accessibility labels
passes.acceptance: Progress and state track real output; malformed IPC cases pass

passes.title: Winamp-layout skeleton
passes.scope: Compact player, navigation sidebar, sortable/searchable table, docked queue and adaptive resizing
passes.acceptance: Layout checks at two sizes and keyboard order validation

passes.title: Play and queue semantics
passes.scope: Double-click/Enter Play Now, multiselect, Play Next, Next/Previous output and EOF advance
passes.acceptance: User-journey tests, no overlapping sinks and operator audio confirmation

passes.title: Playlist editing and persistence
passes.scope: Queue reorder, Finder import, named playlists, safe M3U8 and restart restore without autoplay
passes.acceptance: Persistence, path traversal, Unicode and media-byte preservation tests

passes.title: A/B acceptance
passes.scope: Same-file baseline/candidate, WAV/FLAC, routes, queues, catalog sizes and accessibility
passes.acceptance: Three functional repetitions, five UX pilots and acoustic evidence distinguished from UI state

passes.title: Release evidence handoff
passes.scope: Synchronize task/index/evidence and run offline and macOS release checks
passes.acceptance: Exact observations and blockers recorded; no acceptance claim without evidence
